encrypt-pdf-aes256-forbid-all.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Forbid All Permissions
encrypt-pdf-aes256-forbid-all.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, forbid all permissions, and save the encrypted document.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-no-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with 128‑bit RC4 and No Permissions
encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-no-permissions.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, apply 128‑bit RC4 encryption, forbid all privileges, and save the encrypted document using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-screen-reader.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Enable Screen Reader Permission
encrypt-pdf-aes256-screen-reader.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying 256‑bit AES encryption with user and owner passwords, enabling the screen‑reader permission, and saving the encrypted document.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-screen-reader-permission.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 and Enable Screen Reader Permission
encrypt-pdf-rc4-screen-reader-permission.description: Loads a PDF, applies 128‑bit RC4 encryption with user and owner passwords, enables the ExtractContentWithDisabilities permission (allow screen readers), and saves the encrypted document.

change-pdf-passwords__v4.title: Change PDF Passwords with Aspose.Pdf
change-pdf-passwords__v4.description: Demonstrates opening an encrypted PDF using the owner password, changing both user and owner passwords via Document.ChangePasswords, and saving the re‑encrypted PDF.

encrypt-pdf-and-generate-security-report.title: Encrypt PDF and Generate Security Inspection Report
encrypt-pdf-and-generate-security-report.description: The example encrypts a PDF with AES‑256 using user and owner passwords, applies specific permissions, then inspects the encrypted file’s security flags and permissions and writes a text report.

re-encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-preserve-password.title: Re‑encrypt PDF with RC4 128‑bit preserving passwords
re-encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-preserve-password.description: The example loads an existing encrypted PDF using a user password, re‑applies encryption with the RC4 128‑bit algorithm while keeping the original user and owner passwords and permissions, and saves the newly encrypted file.

change-user-password-encrypted-pdf.title: Change User Password of Encrypted PDF
change-user-password-encrypted-pdf.description: Shows how to verify that a PDF is encrypted, open it with the existing user password, re‑encrypt it with a new user password (keeping the owner password), and save the updated file.

change-owner-password-of-encrypted-pdf.title: Change Owner Password of Encrypted PDF
change-owner-password-of-encrypted-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an encrypted PDF with a user password, binding it to the PdfFileSecurity facade, updating only the owner password, and saving the modified document.

re-encrypt-pdf-with-new-passwords__v2.title: Re‑encrypt PDF with New Passwords and Enable Printing
re-encrypt-pdf-with-new-passwords__v2.description: Loads an existing encrypted PDF, applies new user and owner passwords, enables the print permission, and saves the re‑protected document.

re-encrypt-pdf-disable-printing.title: Re‑encrypt PDF with New Passwords and Disable Printing
re-encrypt-pdf-disable-printing.description: The example loads an already encrypted PDF using its current user password, applies new user and owner passwords, disables printing by setting permissions, and saves the re‑secured document.

re-encrypt-pdf-256-aes.title: Re‑encrypt PDF with New Passwords and 256‑bit AES
re-encrypt-pdf-256-aes.description: Loads an existing encrypted PDF, changes the user and owner passwords, applies 256‑bit AES encryption with specific permissions, and saves the re‑encrypted document.

change-pdf-password-aes-256.title: Change PDF Password and Apply 256‑Bit AES Encryption
change-pdf-password-aes-256.description: Loads an existing encrypted PDF, updates the user and owner passwords, enables printing permission, and re‑encrypts the document with 256‑bit AES encryption before saving it.

change-user-password-of-encrypted-pdf__v.title: Change User Password of Encrypted PDF
change-user-password-of-encrypted-pdf__v.description: Demonstrates loading an encrypted PDF, binding it to PdfFileSecurity, updating only the user password while preserving the owner password, and saving the result.

change-owner-password-of-encrypted-pdf__.title: Change Owner Password of Encrypted PDF
change-owner-password-of-encrypted-pdf__.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with the existing user password, re‑encrypt it with a new owner password while keeping the user password unchanged, and save the updated file.

change-pdf-user-password-enable-print.title: Change PDF User Password and Enable Printing
change-pdf-user-password-enable-print.description: The example loads an encrypted PDF with the current user password, re‑encrypts it using a new user password while granting the PrintDocument permission, and saves the updated file.

update-owner-password-enable-printing.title: Update Owner Password and Enable Printing on Encrypted PDF
update-owner-password-enable-printing.description: Loads an encrypted PDF using the user password, changes the owner password, grants printing permission, and saves the updated PDF.

re-encrypt-pdf-256-aes-change-password.title: Re‑encrypt PDF with 256‑bit AES and Change Password
re-encrypt-pdf-256-aes-change-password.description: Loads an existing password‑protected PDF, updates the user and owner passwords, applies 256‑bit AES encryption with specified permissions, and saves the re‑encrypted document.

re-encrypt-pdf-256-aes-owner-password.title: Re‑encrypt PDF with New Owner Password using 256‑bit AES
re-encrypt-pdf-256-aes-owner-password.description: Demonstrates loading an already encrypted PDF, binding it to PdfFileSecurity, changing the owner password, applying 256‑bit AES encryption, and saving the re‑encrypted document.

re-encrypt-pdf-256-bit-aes.title: Re‑encrypt PDF with New Passwords and 256‑bit AES
re-encrypt-pdf-256-bit-aes.description: Loads an existing password‑protected PDF, changes both user and owner passwords, applies 256‑bit AES encryption, restricts permissions to printing only, and saves the updated document.

change-pdf-user-password-enable-printing.title: Change PDF User Password and Enable Printing while Preserving Encryption
change-pdf-user-password-enable-printing.description: Shows how to load an encrypted PDF, set a new user password, enable printing permission, and re‑save the document without altering the original encryption key size.

re-encrypt-pdf-new-owner-disable-printin.title: Re‑encrypt PDF with New Owner Password and Disable Printing
re-encrypt-pdf-new-owner-disable-printin.description: Loads an encrypted PDF, changes its owner password, removes printing permission, and saves it while preserving strong AES‑256 encryption.

change-pdf-encryption-passwords.title: Change PDF Encryption Passwords
change-pdf-encryption-passwords.description: The example checks if a PDF is encrypted, opens it with the current owner password, and re‑encrypts it using new user and owner passwords while preserving full permissions.

change-pdf-user-password-enable-printing.title: Change PDF User Password and Enable Printing
change-pdf-user-password-enable-printing.description: Demonstrates loading an encrypted PDF, updating the user password, granting print permission, and saving the modified document.

re-encrypt-pdf-disable-printing__v2.title: Re‑encrypt PDF and Disable Printing
re-encrypt-pdf-disable-printing__v2.description: Loads an encrypted PDF, changes the owner password, removes the print permission, and saves the re‑protected file.

change-pdf-passwords__v5.title: Change PDF Passwords Using PdfFileSecurity
change-pdf-passwords__v5.description: Shows how to load an encrypted PDF, bind it to PdfFileSecurity, replace the user and owner passwords while keeping default encryption settings, and save the updated PDF.

change-pdf-passwords-aes256.title: Change PDF Passwords with AES‑256 Encryption
change-pdf-passwords-aes256.description: Loads an existing encrypted PDF, re‑encrypts it with new user and owner passwords using AES‑256, and saves the updated document.

change-user-password-preserve-permission.title: Change User Password of Encrypted PDF While Preserving Permissions
change-user-password-preserve-permission.description: Demonstrates opening an encrypted PDF with the existing user password, retrieving its current permissions, re‑encrypting it with a new user password while keeping the same permissions, and saving the updated file.

update-owner-password-preserve-permissio.title: Update Owner Password of Encrypted PDF While Preserving Permissions
update-owner-password-preserve-permissio.description: Loads an encrypted PDF using the existing user password, retrieves the current permissions, re‑encrypts the document with a new owner password while keeping the original permissions (including printing), and saves the updated file.

re-encrypt-pdf-preserve-encryption.title: Re‑encrypt PDF with New Passwords and Preserve Encryption Settings
re-encrypt-pdf-preserve-encryption.description: Loads an encrypted PDF, changes the user and owner passwords, enables printing, keeps the original encryption key size, and saves the updated PDF.

reprotect-encrypted-pdf-disable-printing.title: Reprotect Encrypted PDF with New Passwords and Disable Printing
reprotect-encrypted-pdf-disable-printing.description: Loads an existing encrypted PDF, applies new user and owner passwords, removes the printing permission, retains the original encryption key size, and saves the updated document.

change-user-password-encrypted-pdf__v2.title: Change User Password of an Encrypted PDF
change-user-password-encrypted-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to verify PDF encryption, open an encrypted document with the current password, re‑encrypt it with a new user password and owner password, and save the updated file.

change-owner-password-of-encrypted-pdf__.title: Change Owner Password of Encrypted PDF
change-owner-password-of-encrypted-pdf__.description: Loads an encrypted PDF, verifies its encryption status, then re‑encrypts it with the same user password but a new owner password and saves the updated file.

change-pdf-passwords-enable-printing-aes.title: Change PDF Passwords and Enable Printing with AES‑256 Encryption
change-pdf-passwords-enable-printing-aes.description: Loads an encrypted PDF using the existing user password, updates both user and owner passwords, grants printing permission, applies AES‑256 encryption, and saves the re‑encrypted document.

change-pdf-password-disable-printing.title: Change PDF Password and Disable Printing with 256‑bit Encryption
change-pdf-password-disable-printing.description: Loads an encrypted PDF, binds it to PdfFileSecurity, changes the user password, disables printing via DocumentPrivilege, applies 256‑bit encryption, and saves the updated file.

check-pdf-encryption-status__v2.title: Check PDF Encryption Status and Write to File
check-pdf-encryption-status__v2.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF to PdfFileInfo, determine if it is encrypted, and write the result to a text file.

check-pdf-encryption-status__v3.title: Check PDF Encryption Status with Aspose.Pdf
check-pdf-encryption-status__v3.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, bind it to a PdfFileInfo object, and determine whether the file is encrypted, then output a plain‑text summary.

encrypt-pdf-aes128-user-owner-password.title: Encrypt PDF with User and Owner Passwords (AES‑128)
encrypt-pdf-aes128-user-owner-password.description: The example loads a PDF, checks whether it already has an edit password, then encrypts the document with a user password "u5" and an owner password "o5" using AES‑128 encryption, and saves the result.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-check-open-password.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 and Verify Open Password
encrypt-pdf-rc4-check-open-password.description: The example loads a PDF, uses PdfFileInfo to check if it has an open password, then encrypts the document with user and owner passwords using the RC4 128‑bit algorithm and saves the encrypted file.

encrypt-pdf-with-passwords-and-permissio.title: Encrypt PDF with User and Owner Passwords
encrypt-pdf-with-passwords-and-permissio.description: The example loads an existing PDF, applies AES‑256 encryption with a user and owner password, grants all standard permissions, and saves the encrypted document.

encrypt-pdf-owner-password-no-permission.title: Encrypt PDF with Owner Password and No Permissions
encrypt-pdf-owner-password-no-permission.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying encryption with only an owner password, disabling all permissions, and saving the encrypted document.

encrypt-pdf-with-passwords-and-copy-perm.title: Encrypt PDF with User/Owner Passwords and Copy Permission
encrypt-pdf-with-passwords-and-copy-perm.description: The example loads an existing PDF, applies AES‑256 encryption with a user and owner password, and restricts permissions to allow only content extraction (copy). The encrypted document is then saved as a new file.

encrypt-pdf-print-only-permission__v2.title: Encrypt PDF with Print‑Only Permission
encrypt-pdf-print-only-permission__v2.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, restricting permissions to printing only, and saving the encrypted document.

encrypt-pdf-forbid-all-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with User and Owner Passwords (Forbid All Permissions)
encrypt-pdf-forbid-all-permissions.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, and restricting all permissions using Aspose.Pdf.
